objective: Define Idea Inbox and Inspiration Engine so a minimal thought can be captured with near-zero friction, triaged into CSW-01 Creative Fragments/Projects, and developed through deterministic prompts/tables/combinators plus optional AI suggestions, while every suggestion remains attributable pre-authoritative material and the system avoids duplicate/truth/visibility bleed.
design_findings: One-field durable capture can remain an ordinary CSW-01 Creative Fragment with inbox lifecycle and no forced project/title/genre/final classification.
Triage is optional organization and remains pre-authoritative.
Deterministic non-AI generators are first-class and include question, transform, connection, role, stakes, variation, seeded table, remix and negative-space primitives.
Generator results are ephemeral until explicit save/apply/branch/alternate/relate disposition.
Saved alternatives keep independent stable IDs and source-version provenance.
Duplicate/related discovery is advisory, authorization-filtered and never silently merges/deletes or leaks hidden candidates.
Source provenance records safe references without copying protected Campaign payload into Personal storage.
Optional AI receives only authorized task-relevant context and returns attributable candidate material with no automatic save/incorporation/publication.
Develop-this loops are bounded and return control to the creator.
Offline mode permits local draft capture only and reconnect uses reauthorization/idempotent reconciliation.
Accessibility/mobile paths require no drag/color/visual-only semantics.
Core capability remains usable without AI.
next_action: Open bounded CSW-03 governance PR, run exact-head AIOC repository-health, merge after PASS, then record completed_verified evidence and select CSW-04.
